text: Dear, I know you’re busy with the shop, but could you please lend me N50,000 for my cousin’s school fees? I need it by Friday 5pm.

My sister, we need volunteers for the soup kitchen this Friday (19 Oct) from 6 pm to 9 pm at the community centre. It’s a tight spot, we’re short by 4 people. If you can bring a dish or just your hands, we’ll bless you plenty.
My dear, could you send me the rent receipt for the shop by tonight? I need it for the bank tomorrow. Please don't forget, it's urgent.
My dear, we are having a family wedding on 22nd July at our house in Ikeja. Please come early to help with the arrangements. We really need you there – it won’t be the same without you.
My child, the youth group wants to start a podcast and they asked if you could guide them on editing. Could you meet them at the church studio on 20th Oct at 4 pm? Your help would mean a lot.
Brother, we are having a special prayer night on 15th Oct, 9pm at St. Michael's Church, Lagos. Please be there, bring your family, and help with the refreshments budget of ₦5,000.
We need your signed contract amendment for the new remote work policy by 4 Oct. Failure to return it may affect your eligibility for the upcoming bonus.
Good afternoon, please remember that the rent for the 3B flat (N150,000) is due on 1st November. If you can’t pay on time, we need to discuss a payment plan.
My dear, I saw the invoice for ₦150,000 you sent. Please settle it before Friday, else I’ll have to remind the landlord again.
Good morning, please submit the revised budget proposal for the Ministry of Health by 0900 tomorrow, 15th March. No delays will be tolerated.

My dear, I hope you’re well. I need to know how you manage your work schedule so I can ask the church committee if we can fit a health talk on 12/5. Please get back soon, I’m counting on you.
Brother Chike, we are having a church fellowship dinner on 5th Nov at 7pm at the community hall. Please bring a dish to share. Your presence would bless us all.

Dear, I need you to collect the parcel from the post office on 12th Oct before 3pm. It's urgent for the family meeting.
Sam, the product team just added a request for a dark‑mode toggle to the UI mockups you delivered last week. Could you squeeze this into the current build? They’re aiming for a demo on 18 Oct.
Abeg, the water pipe wey you fixed dey leak again. Fit check am today? E no good for my kids.
Dear, the water bill for Unit 4B is overdue. Please settle the ₦45,000 balance by 5 Oct to avoid service interruption.
Hi, could you cover my shift on 12th Oct? I have a dentist appointment and the manager is pressuring me.

Hey all, the next release (v2.3) is due 15 Dec and we need a few reviewers for the new authentication module. If you can spare 2 hrs this week, we’ll add you to the contributors list and give you a $50 Amazon gift card.
Guy, you still dey plan that weekend trip to Olumo? The tickets wey I booked go expire tomorrow 5pm. Let me know if you still dey go.
Good morning, Sir. This is a gentle reminder that the rent for the apartment at 2B, Oko Crescent is due on 5th November. Kindly ensure payment of ₦250,000 is made before the due date.
Hey, just a heads‑up: we need the $2,500 invoice #789 paid today to keep the project on track. Let me know once it’s processed.
Please add a safety compliance badge to the flyer you designed for the club’s engineering workshop on 12 Oct. It's mandatory.
My dog keep hearing the music from your shop after 10pm. Please turn it down, e go help us all sleep.
Hi, I’m trying to set up automatic rent payments through the portal and hit a snag. Can you walk me through the steps? I need it done before the 1st of June.
Reminder: your rent for 2026‑10‑01 is now $2,350. Late fees apply after the 5th. Please pay today to avoid any disruption.
Reminder: Community meeting on 5 Nov at 4pm in the building lobby. All tenants must attend to discuss new security measures and rent increase of ₦20,000.

Hello,

We have not received the invoice for the consulting services rendered in August. Please forward the N250,000 invoice by end of day so we can process payment.

Thank you.
My dear, you promised to bring the money for Auntie Bisi’s birthday cake on Friday 20th Oct. You still no send am? No be small thing, the cake dey wait!
Oga, I need the N200,000 rent for March by tomorrow. The bank says we can’t process the repair bills until we get the payment. Please arrange it.
Beloved, please remember to bring the N5,000 offering for the church fund on Sunday, 27 Oct. God bless you for your generosity.
Hey team, reminder that we have the monthly “Happy Hour” on Tuesday, Nov 3rd at 5:30 pm in the rooftop bar. It’s optional but highly encouraged for team bonding. RSVP in the poll.
Dear Mr. Chukwuma, please submit the signed contract for the Abuja office renovation by 3 PM tomorrow (25 Oct). Failure to do so will delay the release of the N2,500,000 payment.
